decisions.reason: As a close extension of the core cutting and creasing range, it is relatively cheap to carry and two years is still early enough that the option value of waiting outweighs abandonment.

The UV spot varnishing system remains the riskiest because it is more distant from the established portfolio, but its strategic flagship role in digital print enhancement still justifies keeping the option open a bit longer.
This sheet preparation module fits naturally into existing postpress workflows and can be maintained with low incremental effort while market demand becomes clearer.
The hybrid saddle stitcher sits squarely in the firm's familiar booklet-making domain, so with no clear failure signal visible there is still little reason to exit now.
As a complementary folding add-on with at least one reference use case, it is inexpensive to keep in the portfolio even though broader sales traction is still somewhat uncertain.
